explanation: Repository configuration for the Visium atlas: package.json adds build:expression-visium and check:expression-visium; .gitignore ignores public/expression/visium/; .gitattributes keeps the pinned Visium TSV tables and the R extractor LF on every checkout; the application workflow builds the Visium atlas in the test job and prepare:deploy builds it in the build job; CHANGELOG.md records the change. The R extractor now reads counts with GetAssayData(layer =), works under R 4.4.1 and R 4.6.0, and notes that Seurat must be installed for the VisiumV1 image class.
